title: Manual Temma firmware replies no longer satisfy driver controls
summary: `indigo_drivers/mount_temma/mount_temma_simulator/mount_temma_simulator.ino:215-225` replies R1 to STN-ON/OFF, and235-236 replies R1 to v1/v2. Current maintained `indigo_mount_temma.driver:149-165` requires exact stn-on/stn-off standby status and a v-prefixed version line for speed selection. Normal tracking/standby and high-speed controls therefore fail against this sketch although it acknowledges them. Its configurable STN_ON_MEANS_MOTORS_ON semantics also require reconciliation with the current driver comment that standby ON means motors OFF. The newer host simulator is a separate component; its passing evidence cannot certify this manual  Full source contracts: helper-manual-review.md H-03. Remedy: update the manual sketch to the current documented reply/state contract, verify connection/configuration, both standby transitions and both speed transitions with matching command/reply fixtures; retain explicit differences for any documented hardware variant. No manual serial session or board run was performed.
evidence: helper-manual-review.md H-03; exact current source paths and firmware/script contracts retained there.
